name: install-fonts
title: Install Fonts
description: Install fonts from Finder selections, folders, or zip files.
author: will_thresher

commands.name: install-fonts
commands.title: Install Fonts
commands.description: Install selected fonts into your Mac user Fonts folder.

preferences.name: trashSourceAfterInstall
preferences.title: Clean Up
preferences.label: Trash source after install
preferences.description: Move the original font file, folder, or zip to the Trash after a successful install.

preferences.name: duplicateHandling
preferences.title: Duplicates
preferences.description: Choose how Install Fonts should handle font files with the same filename as an existing font.

preferences.name: showFinderAfterInstall
preferences.title: Post Install
preferences.label: Show Fonts folder after install
preferences.description: Reveal your user Fonts folder in Finder after a successful install.

preferences.name: fontSelectionMode
preferences.title: Font Versions
preferences.description: Choose whether Install Fonts installs every discovered font or asks you to pick a format when mixed font types are found.

data.title: Ask when mixed formats are found

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
